PREAMB.AGENCY: DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES
PREAMB.SUBJECT: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; Notice of Closed Meeting
PREAMB.P: Pursuant to section 10(d) of the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended, notice is hereby given of the following meeting.

The meeting will be closed to the public in accordance with the provisions set forth in sections 552b(c)(4) and 552b(c)(6), Title 5 U.S.C., as amended. The contract proposals and the discussions could disclose confidential trade secrets or commercial property such as patentable material, and personal information concerning individuals associated with the contract proposals, the disclosure of which would constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.

EXTRACT.P: Name of Committee: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute Special Emphasis Panel; Phase II SBIR Topic 099.
Agenda: To review and evaluate contract proposals.
Place: National Institutes of Health, 6705 Rockledge Drive, Bethesda, MD 20817 (Virtual Meeting).

Contact Person: Kristin Goltry, Ph.D., Scientific Review Officer, Office of Scientific Review/DERA, National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health, 6705 Rockledge Drive, Room 209-B, Bethesda, MD 20892, (301) 435-0297, goltrykl@mail.nih.gov.
This notice is being published less than 15 days prior to the meeting due to the timing limitations imposed by the review and funding cycle.
